headline: Nigerian Opposition Urges Parliament to Block $21.6B Foreign Loan Requests
summary: Nigeria's African Democratic Congress and presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked the National Assembly to reject President Bola Tinubu's external borrowing proposals seeking $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion.
why: Nigeria's sovereign debt sustainability and external borrowing costs are closely tracked by emerging market credit investors and multilateral lenders.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Opposition pushback against new sovereign debt packages highlights political risks surrounding national fiscal deficit financing.
